newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas prices mixed as only two deals done.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas prices mixed as only two deals done.

text.p: The IPE natural gas contract saw two trades on Friday afternoon, totalling 50 lots. The deals followed a blank morning when no deals were done.
The price direction was mixed. Front-month July traded at 9.30 pence a therm, a rise of 0.035 pence from Thursday's close, while October softened by 0.02 pence to trade at 11.00 pence.

Volumes were highly variable over the week. A total of 420 lots was done, with 55 on Monday, 85 on Tuesday, 180 on Wednesday, and 50 each on Thursday and Friday. Prices have also been volatile, swinging up and down in line with developments on the OTC market.
